title: ABS-CBN Music named Filipino Music Awards 2026's Music Company of the Year
summary: ABS-CBN Music was named Music Company of the Year at the Filipino Music Awards 2026, with Kapamilya artists BINI, Maki, and Asia's Songbird Regine Velasquez-Alcasid also taking home top honors.
